FAIL — PdfException: ServerUrl must be provided.

root_cause: TimestampOptions.ServerUrl is a required property. Both constructors fail at Process() time if ServerUrl is null/empty. RFC 3161 timestamping requires an external TSA (Time Stamping Authority) server URL. No offline/self-signed alternative exists in the Aspose.Pdf LowCode API.

tsa_options_investigated.self_signed_workaround: NOT POSSIBLE — TSA server is protocol-level requirement (RFC 3161), not just an API requirement
tsa_options_investigated.public_tsa_feasibility: BLOCKED_IN_CI — outbound HTTPS to TSA servers not available in sandboxed pipeline environments

permanent_block_criteria: Requires external TSA server URL (RFC 3161 protocol requirement)
Network access to public TSA servers not available in pipeline sandbox
Cannot produce deterministic output without TSA connectivity
rerun_condition: Only unblockable if: (1) a local TSA mock server is deployed and accessible in CI/CD, OR (2) a public TSA URL is confirmed reachable from build agents
denominator_impact: Timestamp stays in PILOT_SCOPE_DEFERRED (excluded from allowed_types). Excluded count remains 83.
verdict: PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED — Timestamp LowCode requires external TSA ServerUrl. No workaround available. Stays in PILOT_SCOPE_DEFERRED indefinitely unless CI network policy changes.
